summary: Second-person present tense holds flawlessly across all eleven scored turns and the handler/classroom reveal is genuinely constructed, but the narrator repeatedly commits the operative to decisions the user never made and leans on a few pet images (arithmetic, the bead of plastic) until they go dead.
